example_pinyin: Xuéxí bìng zhǎngwò "纵横" shì tígāo Hànyǔ shuǐpíng de guānjiàn.
example_en: Learning and mastering "纵横" (lit. warp and weft in weaving) is key to improving Chinese proficiency.
